subject: general
question:
A man goes north for 3 km and reaches point B. Then he turns right, goes 10 km to reach point C. Next, he takes a right turn, goes 5 km to reach point D. Then he goes west for 3 km to reach point E. Finally, he turns right and goes 2 km to reach point F. In which direction is the man now with respect to the starting point?

(Note: All turns are 90° turns only unless specified.)
solution:
**Given: **

A man goes north for 3 km and reaches point B.

Then he turns right, goes 10 km to reach point C. 

He takes a right turn, goes 5 km to reach point D.

He goes west for 3 km to reach point E. 

He turns right and goes 2 km to reach point F.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0c2b90c164ff80f253ff3acb05c33bc049bef62ca0c96db87a3044a8da33fcc0.png] 

Therefore, the man is to the East of the starting point.

Hence, the correct answer is Option 4.
